name: Hardship request triage
useWhen: The customer cannot make a payment because of job loss, illness, a death in the family or another hardship.
instructions: Steps: 1. Say you are sorry to hear it. 2. Record the reason the customer gives, in their words. 3. Offer the hardship request form; the hardship team replies within two business days. Rules: do not quote a new payment amount, and do not promise a deferral; the hardship team decides.
guardrails: Promising a payment deferral before the hardship team approves it
refusal: I can't promise a payment deferral; only the hardship team can approve one. I can start a hardship request for your client now, and the team replies within two business days.
